verdict.rationale: Offline evaluation is well documented. Task suites with code and LLM-judge scorers can be run against agent versions in Suite or Compare mode, and frozen suite and environment versions make runs reproducible. The production-to-test path is also claimed: production data becomes staging environments, real conversations are captured and replayed for evaluation, environments support recorded HTTP replays, and Timeline findings can be turned into the next test. missing for 10: detailed docs on converting a specific production trace into a curated task or dataset entry, an explicit dataset-management concept beyond task suites, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
